steps.comment: these end an attempt at ch:h:22 (exits-challenge:h:22:h, exits-challenge:h:22:o, exits-challenge:h:22:q, exits-challenge:h:22:ss); the queue owns the attempt
enter ch:h:22 — unless a reflex already did in the tick before the hold bound (pressed inside, startChallenge LEAVES)
the rollback measured the goal met 984 game-s after entry (diff 1); the time limit is the check's window, 3600 game-s
finish it (the engine completes a challenge whose goal is met as it leaves; otherwise this only leaves) — only while inside: pressed outside, it would ENTER again

queue.comment: ch:h:22 is ended by a reset of h, o, q, ss (the exits-challenge facts). Hold every one, enter, wait for the goal, finish, release. It starts whenever ch:h:22 is unlocked, not completed, and no other challenge of its layer is running.
